summary: Tested the Real Estate module (backend + UI) and Admin Full Control from start to finish. Backend: 27 pytest tests, 26 pass after 2 small fixes I made. The remaining failure is a real bug: one saved search with bad filters crashes the alert loop, so nobody else gets alerts. UI works on desktop: the Redfin-style split map/list with 23 price pins for admin, the empty state for anonymous users, kind tabs (sale 15 / rent 6 / short_stay 2 / room 0 / commercial 1 / land 1), all filters, sort, place search (Los Angeles -> 2 results), search-as-I-move the map, Search worldwide, the save-search dialog with toast, the /signin redirect when logged out, the /real-estate/saved page (toggle alerts, delete, saved homes), favorites, the detail page (OSM iframe loads, OSM/Google Maps/Directions links use the correct coordinates), the tour request (goes to /inquiries/<id> and contains TOUR REQUEST), the inquiry flow, the book-stay link to /rentals/<source_rental_id>, owner controls (mark rented / mark active / delete), and publishing from /real-estate/list (short stay, EUR, geocoded Lisbon, photo upload, guests, amenities). Admin: purge dialog shows counts and the confirm button stays disabled until PURGE is typed (I did NOT confirm). All 9 type pills render. Blog post and recruit city create/edit/delete work in the UI. Users tab: creating a user and editing phone/password works, and the new password logs in. Main problems: the mobile map renders grey for logged-in users, the alert loop is fragile, legacy demo rentals show no /mo unit, and the admin create dialog makes new recruit cities and shop products inactive.

critical.issue: SavedSearchIn.filters is an unvalidated dict. listing_matches() calls float() on min_price/max_price etc. One saved search with filters {min_price:'abc'} raises ValueError ('Task exception was never retrieved' in backend.err.log) and kills the whole loop, so NO later saved searches get alerts. Reproduced (test_malformed_saved_search_does_not_block_others). Fix: validate filters with a Pydantic model (numbers, kinds list, bbox floats) AND wrap each saved search in try/except inside the loop.

minor.issue: FIXED BY T1: it was shadowed by POST /content/{type} (registered first) and returned 400 'Unknown content type: bulk-delete', which broke the admin Content bulk delete button. I moved the route above create_content.
FIXED BY T1: user input went into $regex without escaping, causing 500s. Added re.escape.

Admin-created real_estate does not call notify_matching_searches. Admin create/patch/delete of a rental (category=property) does not call sync_property_rentals, so the mirror stays stale until the next startup sync. Admin edits to a mirrored real_estate row (source_rental_id) are overwritten on the next sync.
Accepts a raw dict with only key whitelisting and no type validation (price/lat could be strings). Use a partial Pydantic model.
No cascade: the user's re_saved_searches and re_favorites stay orphaned, keep matching, and trigger push attempts for users that no longer exist.

The 21 legacy demo listings have price_unit=null and currency=null, so the 6 rent listings show '$2,200' with no '/mo' on cards and the detail page. Backfill price_unit by listing_kind, or fall back in the UI (rent->month, short_stay->night).

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px with listings (admin), the initial fitBounds runs while the map is hidden (list view is the default). Toggling to Map shows a grey map with tiles only in the top-left corner. Call map.invalidateSize() (then refit) when re-mobile-toggle switches to map.

Bool switches default to false and are sent on create, which overrides the backend default is_active=True. A recruit city created in the UI shows INACTIVE (shop products likely the same). Default is_active switches to true for new items.

Enter with more than one geocode hit (e.g. 'Los Angeles') only opens the suggestion list; the map does not fly until a result is clicked. Spec says Enter flies the map. Auto-pick the first result on Enter.
Min/Max price apply only on blur; pressing Enter does nothing.
After the user drags the map away, the 'homes in Los Angeles, Los Angeles County' label stays because the place param is not cleared on manual move.
Listings at the same coordinates (e.g. the 2 Echo Park LA listings) stack, so only one pin is visible. Consider clustering or an offset.

design_issues.screen: RealEstateDetail tour dialog and RealEstateList 'Available from'
issues: Uses the browser's native date/time pickers (input type=date/time) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover.
Sort select is too narrow: 'Price: low → hig' is truncated.
Header plus filters take about 480px of the 844px viewport, leaving a small map
The Ask Lumi FAB overlaps the bottom of the map/list area next to the Map/List toggle
User-created listing shows only the street ('Rua Augusta 100') with no city/country
A single photo appears as both the main image and the thumbnail
Demo short stay reuses the same photo as the sale listing
Description says 'Change the user's profile, role or wallet' when creating a new user

action_items: HIGH: Make saved-search alerts robust. Validate SavedSearchIn.filters with a typed Pydantic model and wrap each saved search in try/except in notify_matching_searches.
HIGH: Fix the mobile map going grey. Call invalidateSize and refit when the Map view is shown (re-mobile-toggle).
Default is_active=true in the admin Content create dialog (recruit_city, shop_product).
Backfill price_unit/currency on legacy demo real_estate rows, or fall back by listing_kind in ReCard/RealEstateDetail.
PlaceSearch: Enter should pick the first result and fly the map.
Admin content: trigger notify_matching_searches on real_estate create, and sync_property_rentals on rental create/patch/delete.
Cascade-delete re_saved_searches and re_favorites when a user is deleted.
Minor: apply price filters on Enter, clear the place label on manual map move, fix the 'citie' typo, widen the sort select, use shadcn date pickers.
critical_code_review_comments: Route order: put static paths (/content/bulk-delete) before parameterized ones (/content/{type}). Fixed here; check the other routers for the same pattern.
Escape every $regex built from user input (re.escape). Fixed for state/city/admin q; the autos/real_estate city filters now escape too.
notify_matching_searches runs in asyncio.create_task with no exception handling; one failure silently drops all remaining alerts.
PATCH /real-estate/{id} takes body: dict; replace it with a partial Pydantic model.
Purge plan counts look sane (123 test users, ~1087 records). It also deletes credentials/media/messages linked to test users, which is intended. NOT executed.

rca of the issue: Alert loop: real_estate_plus.listing_matches does float(f['min_price']) on unvalidated user input; the ValueError propagates out of the `async for` in notify_matching_searches, which runs as a fire-and-forget task, so later saved searches are never evaluated. Repro: POST a saved search with filters {min_price:'abc'}, then POST a saved search with filters {property_types:['land']}; another user POSTs a matching land listing; the second search's match_count stays 0. Mobile map: RealEstate.jsx sets fitTo after the first fetch while the map container is display:none (mobileView='list'); Leaflet computes bounds on a 0x0 size and is never told the size changed when the container is shown.
